selection_basis: The existing incident-decision bank covers SDS leak response. This official Fire and Disaster Management Agency guidance adds temporary-handling controls with a distinct operational boundary; author only propositions that remain specific to the stated emergency temporary-handling context.

pinpoint_scope: Guideline pp.3-4: Class 4 first petroleum static-electricity controls for containers, drum pumps, grounding/bonding, conductive work surfaces, and initial filling flow
Guideline pp.4-5: outdoor preference and ventilation boundaries for dispensing or decanting from drums

candidate_boundaries: Each question must name the temporary storage or handling emergency context; do not present guidance as a universal statutory requirement.
Do not restate canonical questions about generic grounding, ignition-source removal, ventilation, or the Fire Service Act's 10-day approval condition.
Reject standalone recall of the 1 m/s figure unless a full scenario establishes why the flow-control decision is needed.
proposed_families: ground both the Class 4 first-petroleum container and the dispensing pump
distinguish outdoor dispensing from the limited indoor ventilation condition
